summary: Phase 0 POC end-to-end tested. All 8 backend pytest cases pass (real GPT-4o AI analysis, OpenAPI, validation errors 400/413, list newest-first, image retrieval + 404). Frontend full flow verified via Playwright: page loads with correct header, dropzone/select/notes/button testids present, analyze disabled without file, non-image rejected (no preview created), real construction photo uploaded → analyzing indicator → analysis-result-card with FRAME stage badge, HIGH CONFIDENCE, 216-char progress notes, observations list, issues list. History grid updates to 3 records; after full page reload thumbnails still load (naturalWidth=1400).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py line 155: MAX_UPLOAD_BYTES check occurs AFTER reading the entire body into memory (await file.read()). For very large uploads this still consumes RAM before rejecting. Acceptable for POC but consider streaming/Content-Length check for production.
server.py line 168: project_stage validation happens AFTER PIL image decoding. Order is minor but validating form fields first would fail-fast without image work.
server.py line 35: VALID_STAGES contains 'unknown', which means clients can submit project_stage='unknown' via the form — likely unintended (dropdown only exposes 7 real stages).
No pagination on GET /api/photos (hard limit 200) — fine for POC, note for future.
AnalyzePage.jsx: axios call has no explicit timeout; a hung AI request would leave UI in 'analyzing' state indefinitely. Consider client-side timeout + retry.
seed_data_creation: One real AI analysis created during backend tests + one during frontend test (3 records total in history).
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_photos.py is the regression suite. It makes 1 real AI call (~15-25s, costs LLM credits). Real construction photo at /tmp/construction_frame.jpg. History currently has 3 frame-stage records.
